items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Herbie started working with Les McCann. ... Herbie, he was working so much with Les McCann, it was hard to give up that gig.

ctx.x: It doesn’t list the personnel. Then there’s, in ’61, Ron Jefferson, Love Lifted Me; Al Grey, Snap Your Fingers; Billy Mitchell, This is Billy Mitchell.
What’s his name? Plays real funky piano, from L.A. [Les McCann].
